info.name: Activity2-CTADWEBL
info.description:
Laboratory Activity 2 (Advanced Database Design Using MongoDB) - Part 10 sample documents and validation tests for the BulldogEx Shop API.

1. Start the server first: npm run dev (inside marzan-server).
2. Send the requests from top to bottom, or use Run collection. Every successful create saves its _id into the collection variables (userId1, categoryId1, productId1, ...), so later requests can reference it.
3. Requests marked [Validation] are supposed to fail; their tests pass when the API rejects the bad data.

Run it only once on the same database: the second run fails with duplicate email/name errors because the sample documents already exist.

exec: pm.test("Error message mentions: Please enter a valid email address", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Please enter a valid email address"));
pm.test("New categories are listed", () => { const names = pm.response.json().map((c) => c.name); ["Uniforms", "Books", "Sports"].forEach((n) => pm.expect(names).to.include(n)); });
pm.test("Error message mentions: Category name is required", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Category name is required"));
pm.test("Error message mentions: duplicate key", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("duplicate key"));
pm.test("Category is stored as an ObjectId", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().category).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("categoryId1")));

item.name: 3.4 Get products in the Sports category (populated)

exec: pm.test("Category is populated with its name", () => { const list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.length).to.be.above(0); list.forEach((p) => pm.expect(p.category.name).to.eql("Sports")); });
pm.test("Bulldogs Jersey is found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map((p) => p.name)).to.include("bulldogs-jersey"));
pm.test("Error message mentions: Price is required", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Price is required"));
pm.test("Error message mentions: is not a valid stock status", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("is not a valid stock status"));
pm.test("Error message mentions: Category not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Category not found"));

pm.test("User and products are populated", () => { const cart = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(cart.user.email).to.eql("maria.santos@nu.edu.ph"); pm.expect(cart.items[0].product.title).to.eql("NU Uniform Polo"); });
pm.test("Error message mentions: Quantity must be at least 1", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Quantity must be at least 1"));

item.name: 4.6 [Validation] Second cart for the same user

exec: pm.test("Error message mentions: This user already has a cart", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("This user already has a cart"));
pm.test("Price is copied and total is computed (2 x 650 = 1300)", () => { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.items[0].price).to.eql(650); pm.expect(o.totalAmount).to.eql(1300); });

item.name: 5.2 Jose orders a guide and a jersey

exec: pm.test("User is populated", () => { const order = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(order.user.firstName).to.eql("Maria"); pm.expect(order.status).to.eql("Pending"); });
pm.test("Error message mentions: Order must have at least one item", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Order must have at least one item"));
pm.test("Error message mentions: Phone number must be 11 digits and start with 09", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Phone number must be 11 digits and start with 09"));
